description: This file defines configuration properties for integration tests in the Fineract project, specifically for backend environment settings like protocol, host, port, and credentials, fetched either from environment variables or default values.

classes.name: ConfigProperties
classes.description: Main configuration class for integration test settings, containing nested class Backend for backend environment configurations.

classes.name: ConfigProperties.Backend
classes.description: Nested static class holding constants for backend protocol, host, port, username, password, and tenant, retrieved from environment variables or default values.

methods.name: getValueFromEnvOrDefault
methods.description: Static helper method to retrieve environment variable value or fallback to default if not set.
